item.title: GObject and GTK Type System
item.description: GTK builds its object model on GType and GObject. GType records runtime type relationships and metadata; GObject adds reference-counted instances, properties, and signals; GIO and GTK then use those facilities for actions and widgets. C macros generate repetitive registration code, but the object and class layouts remain ordinary C structures.

item.title: GLib Main Loop
item.description: GLib’s event loop separates event descriptions from event dispatch. A GSource describes when work is ready, a GMainContext owns and schedules a set of sources, and a GMainLoop repeatedly iterates one context. Keeping those roles separate makes callback placement, cancellation, and lifetime rules explicit.
